## [3.78.0] - 2026-09-20

### Features

- improve kiosk ordering and configurable buttons
- update localization for technician rules and dialog hints in Arabic, Hebrew, and Russian
- Enhance cash declaration and counting dialogs with fixing declaration logic and company info in reports
- Add declaration reports fetching and dialog for report display
- Add cash declaration threshold settings and declaration report printing
- move fingerprint config to devices
- localize referral partner flow
- add referral partner checkout flow
- integrate Hashavshevet cash and SHVA flows
- add POS customer self-registration
- localize referral partner flow
- add referral partner checkout flow
- support delayed membership joining benefits
- prompt for membership until payment

### Bug Fixes

- reject malformed SHVA report membership
- bound SHVA acknowledgement upload wait
- redact SHVA accounting identifiers from logs

- update Nayax transaction type logic and improve payment method handling
- harden registration recovery
- recover optional self registration flow
- serialize SHVA accounting updates
- harden queued SHVA acknowledgements
- localize registration notices from build context
- prevent duplicate customer sync timeouts
- avoid conflict upsert for fingerprint cache writes
- repair fingerprint cache columns before upsert
- refresh an empty customer cache
- harden referral checkout data readiness
- repair fingerprint cache conflict key
- preserve referral on resumed refunds
- validate referral selections and preserve refunds
- require referral confirmation before payment
- update only the redeemed loyalty card
- keep membership prompt out of phone POS
- make Hashavshevet acknowledgement durable
- harden SHVA broadcasts and terminal logging
- keep cash actions on live POS context
- normalize registration phone input
- require referral confirmation before payment
- refresh benefit availability at date boundaries
- share guarded membership prompts across layouts

### Other Changes

- bundle DigitalPersona runtime in Windows releases
- Add configurable kiosk catalog layout
- sync flutter_pos_api submodule pointer with latest odoo19/development
- Refactor localization in settings and UI components
- refresh SHVA mocks for current API

- update fingerprint API submodule

- pin referral backend manifest fix

- Make fingerprint cancellation cleanup visible
- Restore DLL directory after fingerprint SDK load
- Run fingerprint cancel off runner thread
- Scope fingerprint template cache by POS
- Preserve newer fingerprint open cancellation state
- Gate fingerprint retries on native cancel release
- Handle fingerprint cancel during reader open
- Harden fingerprint native bridge lifecycle
- Stop fingerprint enrollment after cancellation
- Address final fingerprint review feedback

- Address fingerprint PR review feedback
